comparison: Advances Atlas full-suite score to 23 PASS / 0 INCOMPLETE, surpassing control atlas-particle-normal-v2 (readout-4dc982d111099c9b0f33a18e: 22 PASS, 16 FAIL, 0 INCOMPLETE) by +1 PASS (+2 vector flips vector_unequal_mass and vector_unequal_width vs -1 on 12-particle mode_hold at 7/8 modes), bispf-optimized-quintic-v1 (readout-7b017c8ed900b677ebf6bf55: 20 PASS, 16 FAIL, 2 INCOMPLETE, 1 BLOCKED) by +3 PASS, and atlas-particle-normal-v1 (readout-9f0d62f87d1ff351cfef7f98: 17 PASS, 14 FAIL, 3 INCOMPLETE) by +6 PASS.
conclusion: Raising birth_death_cells from 128 to 256 (eliminating noisy 2-particle-per-cell FeatureCellBirthDeath resampling on N=256 vector transfer tasks while refining N=20000 cell resolution) and NormalNoiseManipulator sigma from 0.005 to 0.0065 deterministically achieves 23 PASS, 12 FAIL, 0 INCOMPLETE across 35 executed tasks (13 prerequisite-gated tasks deferred) on prior-ablation-full-suite-v1 under protocol seed 0 (NVIDIA RTX A6000). Observes predicted vector_unequal_mass component_covariance_error=0.30664 <= 0.85 (down from 1.2828 in v2) and flips both vector_unequal_mass and vector_unequal_width (component_covariance_error=0.34328 <= 0.85, down from 2.3235 in v2) to PASS for 6/6 vector transfer passes alongside 4/4 image passes, 2/2 clockfree audit passes, and 2/2 VAE passes, while avoiding the gaussian1d_smoke falsifier (mean_error_sigma=0.04435 <= 0.2).

decision_outcomes.reuse_note: Compatible original receipts; overlapping readouts are not independent runs or additive costs

hypothesis: Raising birth_death_cells from 128 to 256 eliminates under-populated 2-particle-per-cell FeatureCellBirthDeath resampling noise on N=256 vector transfer tasks while refining N=20000 cell resolution, and raising NormalNoiseManipulator sigma from 0.005 to 0.0065 sustains rare-mass and multi-scale intra-mode covariance, flipping both vector_unequal_mass and vector_unequal_width to PASS (6/6 vector tasks) and raising full-suite score to >= 23 PASS / 0 INCOMPLETE on prior-ablation-full-suite-v1 under protocol seed 0.
next_action: Investigate clean-served intra-mode covariance expansion on N=20000 100-mode tasks (grid100/staggered100/rotated100) without repulsive prior penalties that perturb zero_tanh_smoke or enumerated 32-particle image tables, and address joint BiGAN critic balance on five_word_joint_smoke.

study.competing_explanation: If raising birth_death_cells from 128 to 256 and NormalNoiseManipulator sigma from 0.005 to 0.0065 fails to bring vector_unequal_mass and vector_unequal_width below component_covariance_error <= 0.85 or regresses enumerated image, VAE, AE, or behavioral tasks below 23 PASS, then the vector covariance errors stem from critic/generator equilibrium shrinkage rather than under-populated 2-particle-per-cell FeatureCellBirthDeath resampling and rare-mode local noise support.
